payload.summary: Pure internal refactor target located: src/greeting.mjs contains a single exported function greet(name) whose body is the entire greeting-string construction (`return \`Hello, ${name}!\`;`, lines 1-3). Extraction into new internal module src/format.mjs is straightforward: no other source file exists in src/, and exactly two consumers import greet (scripts/validate.mjs, scripts/contract.mjs), both via `import { greet } from "../src/greeting.mjs"`. Public surface constraint is enforced deterministically by scripts/contract.mjs, which dynamically imports src/greeting.mjs and fails on any export key outside ["greet","FAREWELL"] — so greeting.mjs must keep exporting only greet and must NOT re-export anything from format.mjs. Both configured validators (validation.commands id=fixture-greeting -> `node scripts/validate.mjs`; validators id=contract-test -> `node scripts/contract.mjs`) and package.json `npm test` rely solely on greet's observable behavior (typeof greet === "function" && greet("AEH") === "Hello, AEH!"). No new dependencies, no test framework, no lint config; ESM requires the `./format.mjs` extension in the import specifier.
